what: Hovering an underlined word attaches a sticky-note annotation 14px beside the cursor. sticky (default) is one pink note (328px) that appears with just its title standing in .14s, then 50ms later the body unfolds downward and the panel grows to 234px (.16s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)). stack pops out A·B·C circles (63px) at 120ms intervals from .45→1× in .14s, 40ms later the side notes unfold left to right at 120ms intervals in .16s, then each line is typed 20ms later, title then body, at 4ms per character (blinking cursor). lines overlaps notes coming out from the top at 160·170ms intervals, and text spreads line by line at 55ms intervals over .52s. On leave it disappears over .24s after 160ms. On touch, tap to open and tap elsewhere to close

options.step: Typing interval per character (ms), default 4 — stack
options.x: Offset to the right of the cursor (px), default 14
options.--fx-note: Note color — set per section by the child note’s style, default --kf-accent-soft
options.--fx-note-h: Height the sticky note grows to (css), default 234px
options.[data-fx-part=note]: A single note — data-title is the title, the text is the body. stack and lines hold several (A·B·C …)

use: Underlined wordYour body text here
note: Loading CustomEase gives the curve at the original values exactly, without it the curve is power3.out

from.where: index.html hero underlined words (lines) · mission paper underlined words (sticky) — original ContentAnnotation (three types: hero, mission, sticky)
